scheme_name: Promotion of Energy Audit and Conservation of Energy (PEACE): Detailed Energy Audit
other_conditions: All existing manufacturing MSMEs in Tamil Nadu undertaking energy audits for the first time are eligible.
MSMEs may undertake subsequent energy audits after a minimum gap of three years.
Enterprises with more than one unit can avail the concession separately for each unit.
The subsidy applies only to professional charges incurred for conducting an energy audit.
benefits_summary: 75% subsidy of the audit cost up to ₹1,00,000 per energy audit.
